page 4, Fig. 2b: P=O stretch shifts from 1200 to 1100 cm-1

findings.claim: Authors' interpretation: the phosphonic acid is deprotonated on binding.
Authors' interpretation: P-O groups coordinate surface Pb.

structural_constraints.value: at least one P-OH is deprotonated (phosphonate anion)
structural_constraints.derivation: The P-OH band at 950 cm-1 disappears after binding; the authors conclude that the phosphonic acid is deprotonated on binding.

The P-OH band at 950 cm-1 disappears after binding and the P=O stretch shifts from 1200 to 1100 cm-1 (the authors: P-O groups coordinate surface Pb). Also supported by XPS: P 2p peak at 133.2 eV after treatment (XPS:O2, evidence E6).

caveats: Synthetic fixture: hand-written, not extracted from a real paper.
Not provided by the paper: binding denticity (monodentate versus bidentate phosphonate binding).
Not provided by the paper: degree of deprotonation (one or two P-OH groups); the loss of the P-OH band shows only that at least one P-OH is deprotonated.
Not provided by the paper: ligand coverage per nm^2 (ligand surface coverage).
